ErrorLogs.actionDeleteAllExplainer: Are you sure you want to delete all collected error messages? This action cannot be undone.
ErrorLogs.explainer: Error messages are also part of the feedback. Some issues are automatically resolved by the system, and your operations continue uninterrupted. However, it is helpful for us to be informed about these errors ourselves so we can resolve them.
ErrorLogs.explainerSecrecy: Please ensure that error messages do not contain confidential and/or personal data. The system is designed in principle to ensure that error messages do not include such data. However, the nature of error messages relates to unforeseen circumstances. Therefore, please personally review the feedback for security reasons.
